fusions.name: Mile-Eater
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Column Fire
fusions.desc: Looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 20 damage and ignoring armour. Their damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Marching Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Roadwise
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
